description: "Workflow as tool": WRITE-capable tools over the Dagster instance (materialize_assets, run_job) for agents -- each a real, synchronous dagster.execute_job run, not a read-only query. Registers a resource and ships a stdio MCP server (python -m <module>) for agentic_pipeline's tool_use_loop / mcp_call. A deliberately separate component from the read-only dagster_instance_tools.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Resource key the toolset is registered under

definitions_module.label: Definitions Module
definitions_module.description: Required 'pkg.module[:attr]' that yields the Definitions this tool is allowed to materialize/run (attr defaults to `defs`). Unlike dagster_instance_tools (read-only), a write tool must know its own scope -- there is no 'degrade gracefully without it' mode here.

allow.label: Allow
allow.description: Hard allow-list of tools (default: all). Valid: materialize_assets, run_job.

allow_assets.label: Allow Assets
allow_assets.description: Hard allow-list of asset keys materialize_assets may target (default: any asset in definitions_module). Recommended in production -- an agent should materialize specific, intended assets, not anything in the repo.

allow_jobs.label: Allow Jobs
allow_jobs.description: Hard allow-list of job names run_job may target (default: any job in definitions_module).

default_tags.label: Default Tags
default_tags.description: Tags merged onto every triggered run, alongside dagster-community/workflow-tool=true (e.g. {'triggered_by': 'support-agent'}) -- for run-tag attribution/audit.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource (same name/type/command/env shape as MCPServerResource) under this key, built from this component's own settings -- python -m this module, with DAGSTER_HOME and the DAGSTER_WORKFLOW_TOOLS_* env vars set automatically from definitions_module/allow/allow_assets/allow_jobs/default_tags. Any mcp_servers-aware component (mcp_tool_call, mcp_tool_picker, the agent components, agentic_pipeline) can then reference it via server_resource_key instead of hand-writing an inline command+env entry. Leave unset to skip this -- existing resource_key-only behavior is unchanged.
